output.summary: A low evergreen shrub native to northeastern North America, eastern teaberry has wintergreen-scented leaves and red fruits. Its mildly sweet fruits are edible, while dried leaves and branches are infused as herbal tea; significant essential oil from the leaves requires at least three days of fermentation.
output.edibilityNote: Fruits are eaten; dried leaves and branches make tea. Leaves require at least three days’ fermentation to yield significant essential oil.
